latestTerminalSummary:
The single native Goal was activated, passed the binding guard, and completed. Its exact activation and completion responses are saved in [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/critic/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/critic/native-goal-terminal.json).

The review found no material wrong correction. It flags an incomplete export-fidelity analysis and missing version context for the H5P accessibility issue; a contributor said they could not reproduce the reported behavior with NVDA and requested version details, while the issue remains open ([issue #186](https://github.com/h5p/h5p-multi-choice/issues/186)). The draft also omits that H5P downloads must be enabled in Display options ([H5P guide](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/import-and-export?page=2)).

The complete [critique](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/critic/critique.md), independent [source map](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/critic/source-map.json), and [source index](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P02-treatment/run/B10-P02-treatment/stages/critic/sources/index.md) are saved in the assigned stage. Product and accessibility validations remain proposed, not executed.
